findings.title: Removing public helper parse_optional_int breaks collection of tests/test_filter_overrides.py with ImportError
findings.problem: The diff deletes `parse_optional_int` from `roonseek.web._filter_overrides`. But tests/test_filter_overrides.py:7-14 still imports it at module level, and lines 155-170 still call it. Pytest will fail to collect that module with an ImportError. Every test in the file stops running, including all the merge_overrides and parse_csv_list tests, not just the three parse_optional_int tests, and the suite exits non-zero.
findings.current_code:
from roonseek.web._filter_overrides import (
    ALLOWED_OVERRIDE_KEYS,
    INT_KEYS,
    LIST_KEYS,
    merge_overrides,
    parse_csv_list,
    parse_optional_int,
)
findings.fix_hint: Either remove the parse_optional_int import and Tests 15-17 (lines 151-170) from tests/test_filter_overrides.py in the same change, or keep the helper and have _overrides_from_form call it
findings.why_it_matters: CI goes red. The whole merge_overrides test module (the T-7-04 allowlist coverage) silently stops running until the test file is fixed, which removes coverage of the security-relevant validator.

findings.title: parse_optional_int removed from _filter_overrides.py but still imported by the test suite
findings.problem: The diff deletes parse_optional_int from src/roonseek/web/_filter_overrides.py entirely (and drops it from library.py's import line), but tests/test_filter_overrides.py still does `from roonseek.web._filter_overrides import (... parse_optional_int)` at line 7-14 and has three tests (lines 155-170) that call it directly.
findings.current_code:
from roonseek.web._filter_overrides import (
    ALLOWED_OVERRIDE_KEYS,
    INT_KEYS,
    LIST_KEYS,
    merge_overrides,
    parse_csv_list,
    parse_optional_int,
)
findings.fix_hint: Either keep a thin parse_optional_int wrapper in _filter_overrides.py for backward compatibility, or update tests/test_filter_overrides.py to drop the import and the three parse_optional_int tests (they're now effectively covered by the inlined int(raw) logic in _overrides_from_form).
findings.why_it_matters: This import is evaluated at module load time, so pytest collection of tests/test_filter_overrides.py will raise ImportError, failing the entire test module (not just the 3 tests that call the function) — likely breaking CI for this change.

members.title: Removed public helper parse_optional_int is still imported by its unit test module
members.problem: The diff deletes `parse_optional_int` from src/roonseek/web/_filter_overrides.py. tests/test_filter_overrides.py still imports it (line 13) and calls it in three tests (lines 155-170). That import fails at collection time, so the whole test module errors out, including the merge_overrides and parse_csv_list tests that have nothing to do with this change. git grep confirms the test file is now the only remaining reference.
members.why_it_matters: An ImportError at collection turns the module's tests for the allowlist (T-7-04) and merge validation into collection errors rather than test results. That hides coverage for the security-relevant merge_overrides path.
members.fix_hint: Delete the parse_optional_int import and its three tests (Tests 15-17), or keep the helper and use it in _overrides_from_form instead of a bare int()
